title: Code 430 retaining walls v0
description: Optional file in a map pack (add-retaining-walls). Vertical retaining walls where the ground rises steeply beside a road: the foot line of each (on the ground in front, at the road's or sidewalk's level) and its height above each point. The game extrudes a concrete wall from each point up by its top, interpolating the top between points and where it splits the wall at a chunk boundary; height_m is the tallest top, for bounds. tops_m must be as long as points: the pack validator checks that, and the game skips a wall that fails it. A game from before this file ignores it.

id.description: w:<edge id>:<side l or r><run number on that side>

tops_m.description: height of the wall above each point, one per entry of points
